_about: the COCONUT PALM (Cocos nucifera): a tall slender grey trunk, ringed by the scars of fallen fronds, swollen at its foot and curving up from a long lean (toward the sea and the light); a crown of long arching feather fronds whose many narrow leaflets hang from the rachis; under them, round the heart, bunches of big green-to-yellow nuts (crown.nuts, grown as bodies of their own)
